mentions.name: Recoil
mentions.description: Recoil is a memory-safe, compiled static programming language with Rebol syntax and built-in features such as parsing, a finite state machine, and rich syntax. Its Rebol-based syntax is noted for being near-optimal from an entropy standpoint, yielding lower token usage.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on Recoil, memory safe, compiled static language (yeah, I know, everybody’s doing it) with Rebol syntax and built-in candies like parsing, finite state machine and rich syntax (that’s given, because of Rebol).
